options.label: A — Soft window light
options.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: brand-new App Store header concept for Endless Crown, wide 21:9.
Input images: Image 1 is an authentic app screenshot: use it as the exact display-content reference. Image 2 is official Apple Watch hardware: use its case, band, and compact single Crown proportions as a physical reference. Both are references for a NEW photograph and layout, not edit targets.
Subject: an adult left wrist wearing one silver Apple Watch with a charcoal sport band. The opposite right index finger is actively rolling the Digital Crown. The fleshy fingertip naturally overlaps and covers about 50–65 percent of the upper/outward Crown surface, leaving just a small lower crescent of one compact knurled wheel visible next to the case. The finger is in direct contact with the Crown. The thumb is relaxed well below it. Make one shallow Crown with no outward shaft. Believable hand anatomy and pressure at the contact point; keep the finger clear of the Watch screen.
Display: use the authentic screenshot's black background, gray rounded full-width rows, selected white "4698", neighboring values 4695, 4696, 4697, 4699, 4700, bold clock "7:44", and translucent gray "Clicks" pill with its white hand icon and underlying row overlap. Match the screenshot's actual typography and vertical layout, including the clipped edge rows. Perspective-map this content coherently to the glass of the new Watch so its borders align with the case. Do not reimagine or rearrange the UI, remove the real clock, change the counter, or add statistics.
Style: realistic candid editorial product photography with subtle skin pores, fine hair, natural nails, lived-in fabric, soft believable shadows, restrained neutral colors. The Watch is the sharp focal point; background gently blurred. No exaggerated cinematic grading.
Text (verbatim): small "Endless Crown" and two prominent lines "Turn the Crown." and "Feel the haptics.". Crisp quiet sans-serif, easy to read, normal capitalization, no other copy.
Composition: create a complete NEW photographic composition. Headline occupies uncluttered left-side negative space; wrist and Watch are on the right. The display is large and legible. Keep headline and Watch inside comfortable margins. Opaque background, high-resolution wide landscape.
Constraints: one Watch, one Crown, no secondary protruding concentric knob, no large toothed gear, no duplicate button, no extra or fused fingers, no glossy plastic skin, no inaccurate UI text, no floating screen overlay. Make the fingertip's partial Crown occlusion clearly visible.
Scene: a fresh home scene in diffuse daylight. Light gray cotton cuff rather than knitted sleeve; soft charcoal/taupe background with generous negative space. Wrist runs diagonally from lower center to upper right. Watch face is close to frontal with a gentle 10-degree tilt. Index finger reaches diagonally downward from upper right and partly covers the Crown. White/off-white headline on the subdued left background. Quiet natural everyday photograph.
